basic_info.description:
Welcome to Sunny Brisbane!

Discover the perfect blend of luxury, comfort, and convenience in this top-floor, 3-bedroom, 2-bath condo located in Altamar at the Ridge community. This 1,550 sq. ft. remodeled home is bathed in natural light and features an open floor plan, a gas fireplace, and a private balcony with breathtaking views of the San Bruno Mountains.

Designed for effortless living, the unit offers an in-unit washer and dryer, ample storage, and two designated parking spaces, with plenty of guest parking available. Located just minutes from San Francisco, South San Franciscos Biotech Hub, and SFO Airport, this prime location provides easy access to Highways 101 and 280, making commuting  and jet-setting a breeze.

Outdoor enthusiasts will love being steps from San Bruno Mountain State Park, with hiking and biking trails, as well as nearby tennis and pickleball courts. Enjoy the best of both worlds, peaceful surroundings in a welcoming community while staying close to the energy of the city.

Whether you're searching for your dream home or a prime investment opportunity, this condo offers a lifestyle you wont want to miss!
